title: NKTP Health
description: Operational health of NKTP workloads and their telemetry pipelines. Start with workload readiness, scrape failures and queue pressure, then inspect faults and each signal path. Missing data is unknown, not healthy. Collector native metrics cover all NKTP services in the selected datasource. Workload namespace filters Kubernetes state and namespaced scrapes.

list.description: Filters Kubernetes workload state and namespaced scrape targets. Collector native telemetry has no namespace attribute and covers all NKTP services in the selected datasource.

panels.description: Failed current scrapes of Operator, kube-state-metrics, node exporter, kubelet and the bundled backend Collector. Counts both kube-state-metrics endpoints. Target Allocators push metrics and are covered by workload readiness. A missing target is not a successful scrape.

panels.title: Longest completed export
panels.description: Longest observed pipeline export span per time bucket, across replicas of each role. Includes sending and retry backoff. Excludes queue residence and batching before the export starts. Uses completed internal spans, so an export still in progress is not represented. Requires Tempo TraceQL metrics.

panels.title: Queue admission delay
panels.description: Longest observed call to enter an exporter queue, across replicas of each role. Includes blocking while a queue is full. Does not measure time spent waiting after admission. Uses completed internal spans and requires Tempo TraceQL metrics.
